Both finalists, along with Morocco and Algeria, qualified for next year's Women's World Cup in Brazil. Publicado también por: Al Jazeera English, Africanews. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Temperatures could drop by more than 15C compared with last Thursday as cold front moves arrives from Monday Relief from the unrelenting heat is finally arriving this week across western Europe, with more unsettled conditions bringing the chance of rain. item.title: A 52-slab Nebraska bridge turns concrete into giant resistor, warming road during snowstorms
item.description: A Nebraska bridge is using 52 slabs of conductive concrete that can heat its surface and melt snow and ice during winter storms. Developed by University of Nebraska-Lincoln professor Chris Tuan, the technology uses steel shavings and carbon particles to carry electricity through the concrete. The system could reduce the need for de-icing chemicals at bridges, airport tarmacs, intersections and other icy areas. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
